obligations.title: Maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards for Customer Data.
Process Personal Data only on the Customer's documented instructions.
Investigate and mitigate each confirmed Security Incident.
Make Customer Data available for export on written request after expiry or termination.
Restore suspended access promptly once the cause is resolved.
Maintain the confidentiality of access credentials.
Establish lawful basis, provide notices and obtain consents for Personal Data supplied to the Supplier.
Protect Confidential Information with at least reasonable care and limit its use and disclosure, for two years after the Agreement ends.
Return or destroy the other Party's Confidential Information on request after termination or expiry.
